name: LimeSurvey Community Edition Self-Hosted
free_limit: GPL-2.0-or-later open-source self-hosted survey platform; free Community Edition download and operation on your own infrastructure without vendor-managed response or survey quotas.
watch_out: Requires your own PHP web server, database, backups, updates and outbound email configuration. Hosting, support, email and integrations can cost money; LimeSurvey Cloud is a separate hosted product. GPL conditions and provider trademarks remain applicable.
